description: Scope declarations and install-time variable resolution rules.

global.label: Global
global.description: Install into the agent-specific user home directory.

OPENCODE_CONFIG_HOME.description: OpenCode config home; resolved before transformation and never written into tracked config.

CODEX_HOME.description: Codex home; resolved before transformation and never written into tracked config.

COPILOT_HOME.description: GitHub Copilot CLI config home; resolved before transformation and never written into tracked config.

HOME.description: Current user home directory from the runtime.

PROJECT_ROOT.description: Project root supplied by --project or the current working directory.

surfacePolicy.description: Each agent and scope produces one native tree regardless of the number of reported surfaces.

hardwareProfile.description: DCM derives guidance from built-in Node os signals only.
caveats: Native compaction remains authoritative and no UI responsiveness is guaranteed.
